Can you share whether Redwood can provide a custom per-token discount for this scale, and what the minimal commit looks like?

I've attached our Q1 usage export to help.

[Attachment: Siren_Usage_Report_Q1.pdf (pdf)]

Looking for a short scoping call tomorrow or Thursday — Sara (cc finance)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Karthik / Naomi — forwarding Siren's ask. Key facts from prospect: quarterly commit preferred; expected ramp to ~500M tokens/month by month 3. They want: committed per-token price, overage, and confirmation on caching billing.

My suggested commercial starting point (for approval):
- Commit structure: 3-month quarterly commit with monthly commit floor of 200M tokens (total 600M tokens across quarter)
- Committed rate: $0.006 per 1k tokens (blended) for committed volumes
- Overage: $0.0075 per 1k tokens on usage above monthly floor
- Per-token billing includes both generation and advisory consumption; KV/cache hits not billed separately but counted toward token consumption under our current hosted accounting.
- SLA: standard hosted SLA, with 99.5% availability and automatic fallback to a compatible variant if capacity constrained.

I attached a one-page proposal (commit_proposal_siren_v1.xlsx) and the ratecard. This would be a custom slab and needs your sign-off to move to procurement / legal for a short-term amendment.

Pros: predictable unit economics for client and committed revenue for us.
Cons: price below published slabs for that model — will reduce margin; recommend gating on a 3-month upfront deposit or credit.

Asking: quick greenlight (yes / yes-with-conditions / no). If yes-with-conditions, propose: 50% upfront prepayment of committed tokens or ACH-approved credit terms.

Thanks,
Ben

[Attachment: commit_proposal_siren_v1.xlsx]

Ben — reviewed the numbers and the attached usage. My take: the proposed committed blended rate of $0.006/1k is reasonable for an initial commercial; it sits below our listed slab but above the deep-discount thresholds we reserve for multi-quarter enterprise commits. Approve with conditions:

1) Require 50% of the quarter's committed spend as deposit or a signed purchase order with 30-day invoicing.
2) Limit the custom slab to a single quarter (trial), with defined metrics to evaluate after month 3 (latency, error rate, and realized token ramp).
3) Add a floor on average monthly usage across the quarter — if average < 170M/month, then we revert to published ratecard for subsequent months and reconcile.

If Naomi concurs, I authorize Ben to present the proposal to Siren and start procurement paperwork.

Karthik
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Ben / Karthik / Sara — I agree with the conditional approval. Please proceed with the following final terms for the quarter trial (to be captured in a short amendment):

- Commit: quarterly (Jul 1 — Sep 30) with monthly floor 200M tokens.
- Pricing: $0.006 / 1k tokens on committed usage; $0.0075 / 1k tokens overage.
- Deposit: 50% of quarter commit due on signature.
- Trial cap & review: if average monthly usage < 170M, we will reconcile to ratecard and discuss adjustments; if SLA regressions > predefined thresholds, Siren may request remediation credits per the SLA.
- DocuSign: please send the amendment to sara.mei@siren.io and finance@siren.io; include the commit appendix and the usage definitions.

Ben — loop in Legal / Procurement for the amendment and send the DocuSign link. Sara — thanks, we look forward to a quick procurement turnaround.

Best,
Naomi
